navigation.question: What navigation methods do your mobile robots support?
navigation.answer: Our mobile robots support multiple navigation methods including laser SLAM, visual navigation, QR code navigation, etc. They can be flexibly configured according to customer site environments to meet diverse application needs.

development.question: Does the robot control system support secondary development and system integration?
development.answer: Yes. We provide open SDK and API for customers to facilitate secondary development and integration with third-party systems, helping to achieve personalized function expansion.

customization.question: Can robots or systems be customized according to customer requirements?
customization.answer: Yes. We support custom software and hardware development, including structure, functions, interfaces and other aspects. Please contact us to discuss specific requirements.

companyIntroDetailed.para1: Hangzhou ZeroAnt Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise founded by the research team from Beihang University Hangzhou Innovation Research Institute, focusing on the R&D of intelligent robot complete solutions. Currently, it provides highly reliable robot intelligent system solutions for biopharmaceutical, semiconductor and other industries.
companyIntroDetailed.para2: The company relies on the Zhejiang Provincial Key Laboratory of Industrial Big Data and Robot Intelligent Systems, independently developing AiROS (Intelligent Robot Operating System), conquering core technologies such as mobile robot autonomous navigation, high-speed and high-precision control of robotic arms, 3D spatial semantic perception, and multi-robot collaborative scheduling, creating a full-stack software ecosystem and modular hardware platform.
companyIntroDetailed.para3: The team has established ongoing collaboration with universities and research institutes, forming a closed-loop innovation system of industry, academia, research and application. ZeroAnt continues to advance robotics R&D and industrial deployment with fully self-developed and controllable technology, serving manufacturing digitalization and intelligent upgrading.
companyIntroDetailed.financingDesc: The team is currently in the angel round financing stage. If you are interested in the team or have cooperation intentions, please contact us by email. Startup teams value time, no casual inquiries please!

team.background: Research team from Beihang University Hangzhou Innovation Research Institute, focused on robot systems and core technology R&D.

outdoor-patrol-robot.title: Outdoor Mobile Patrol Robot

gantry-2d3d.title: 2/3-DOF Gantry Robot

assembly-robot.title: Assembly Robot

mobile-robot-chassis.title: Self-Developed Mobile Robot Chassis

fixed-rail-transfer-robot.title: Fixed Rail Transfer Robot

vr-remote-franka-dual-arm.title: VR Remote Franka Dual-Arm Robot
vr-remote-franka-dual-arm.desc: Showcases ZeroAnt Technology's VR-based remote operation system for Franka dual-arm robots, achieving precise remote control through immersive interaction interfaces. robotstudio-remote-control.title: RobotStudio IDE Control
robotstudio-remote-control.desc: Demonstrates ZeroAnt Technology's advanced upper computer remote control technology, achieving seamless integration and remote operation of industrial robots through RobotStudio IDE. Showcases real-time robot control and simulation capabilities.

about.title: About ZeroAnt Technology - Industrial Robotics Technology Innovation Enterprise
about.description: ZeroAnt Technology was founded in Hangzhou as a high-tech enterprise focused on industrial robotics innovation. The company develops its own AiROS robotic operating system and has accumulated capabilities in robot control, machine vision and artificial intelligence, serving manufacturing customers with industrial robot products and smart manufacturing solutions.
about.keywords: ZeroAnt Technology, about us, company introduction, industrial robotics company, Hangzhou robotics enterprise, high-tech company, AiROS system, robotics technology innovation, smart manufacturing enterprise, automation company, robot control technology, artificial intelligence, corporate culture, development history, technical strength, core team

precisionWorkcell.name: Precision Transfer & Assembly Solutions
precisionWorkcell.description: High-precision transfer, assembly, and surface-treatment solutions built around R-series arms, lift platforms, and controller hardware

mobileCollaboration.name: Mobile Transfer & Composite Work Solutions
mobileCollaboration.description: Transfer and linked-work solutions built around M / MR mobile bases and composite robots

embodiedDevelopment.name: Embodied Development & Teleoperation Validation Solutions
embodiedDevelopment.description: Embodied development platforms built around MR3T, VR teleoperation, master-slave teleoperation, and drawing workflows

roboticsEngineer.title: Robotics Engineer
roboticsEngineer.description: Develop and optimize industrial robot systems, work on robot control algorithms and mechanical design.
roboticsEngineer.qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, or related field. 3+ years experience in industrial robotics.
roboticsEngineer.responsibilities: Design and develop robotic systems, optimize control algorithms, collaborate with cross-functional teams.

algorithmEngineer.title: Algorithm Engineer
algorithmEngineer.description: Develop AI algorithms for robot perception, planning, and control systems.
algorithmEngineer.qualifications: Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, or related field. Strong background in machine learning and robotics.
algorithmEngineer.responsibilities: Develop AI algorithms, implement machine learning models, optimize robot performance.

softwareEngineer.title: Software Development Engineer
softwareEngineer.description: Develop software systems for robot control, user interfaces, and system integration.
softwareEngineer.qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering or Computer Science. Proficiency in C++, Python, and embedded systems.
softwareEngineer.responsibilities: Develop robot control software, create user interfaces, integrate hardware and software systems.

support.q1: What technical support services does ZeroAnt Technology provide?
support.a1: We provide robot installation and commissioning, technical training, remote diagnostics, preventive maintenance, spare-parts support and day-to-day technical support.
support.q2: How can I get technical support for my industrial robot?
support.a2: You can contact our technical support team through phone, email, or online support system. Our experienced engineers provide rapid response technical consultation and on-site services.
support.q3: Do you provide training for robot operation and maintenance?
support.a3: Yes, we offer comprehensive technical training programs covering robot operation, programming, maintenance, and troubleshooting to ensure optimal equipment performance.
support.q4: What is the warranty period for ZeroAnt robots?
support.a4: Our industrial robots come with comprehensive warranty coverage. Please contact our support team for specific warranty terms and conditions for your product model.

common.ctaDescription: Tell us the workstation type, takt target, and space constraints. The team can help confirm the right model, controller, and accessory combination.

hero.title: Start with families, then models, then extensions.
hero.description: Browse current products and key specs by family first, then move into the right model details faster.

overview.title: Browse by family first. Compare model differences next.
overview.description: Start from R / M / MR, embodied and development platforms, controller, and accessories, then move into specific models under each family. Accessories stay in their own section.

family.title: Start by family
family.description: Confirm whether the need belongs to R, M, MR, embodied and development platforms, controller, or accessories before opening a specific model.

difference.title: Check the key difference inside a family
difference.description: For example, ZA-R3 / ZA-R3X is mainly separated by SCARA arm length, while ZA-R3L / ZA-R3M / ZA-R3H is mainly separated by column height and Z-axis travel.

accessories.title: Match accessories after the robot body
accessories.description: Rail platform and rotating platform are shown in a separate section and are usually matched after the robot body is clear.

rSeries.title: R Series
rSeries.intro: Precision arm platforms for transfer and confined-space operation. Use arm length, column height, body form, and linked configuration to narrow the right model.

zar3x.title: ZA-R3 / ZA-R3X
zar3x.summary: A SCARA transfer platform where ZA-R3 and ZA-R3X are primarily selected by SCARA arm length, suited to high-speed pick-and-place and compact workstations.
specs: SCARA arm length: ZA-R3 450mm / ZA-R3X 592mm horizontal reach

zar3d6.title: ZA-R3D6
zar3d6.summary: A 6-axis arm for more complex orientations and path control.

zar3lmh.title: ZA-R3L / ZA-R3M / ZA-R3H
zar3lmh.summary: A SCARA lift platform where ZA-R3L, ZA-R3M, and ZA-R3H are primarily selected by column height and Z-axis travel.
specs: Key difference: column height / Z-axis travel
Selection cue: choose L / M / H by station height and vertical travel first

zar3mleft.title: ZA-R3M(L) Rail-Integrated
zar3mleft.summary: A rail-integrated ZA-R3M configuration for extending long-travel linear operation range.
specs: Scenario: Cross-station linear pick-and-place and linked transfer
Selection cue: Rail travel, takt requirements, and overall footprint

zar3mright.title: ZA-R3M(R) Rotary-Platform Integrated
zar3mright.summary: A rotating-platform-integrated ZA-R3M configuration for transfer and orientation adjustment.
specs: Scenario: Multi-angle station transfer and posture adjustment
Selection cue: Rotation precision, takt requirements, and station layout

zar3t.title: ZA-R3T
zar3t.summary: An embodied dual-arm robot for bimanual operation, embodied training, and demonstration workflows.

mSeries.title: M Series
mSeries.intro: Mobile bases, first selected by payload, footprint, and station rhythm.

zam75.title: ZA-M75
zam75.summary: A light-duty mobile base for flexible deployment and mid-light transport.

zam135.title: ZA-M135
zam135.summary: A mid-load mobile base for higher-payload transfer across workstations.

mrSeries.title: MR Series
mrSeries.intro: Composite robotic platforms that combine mobility, lift, and manipulation into one cross-area unit.

zamr3m.title: ZA-MR3M
zamr3m.summary: A composite robot platform that integrates a high-performance autonomous mobile base with a customized four-axis robotic arm for cross-area, multi-height workflows.

zamr3t.title: ZA-MR3T
zamr3t.summary: A highly integrated humanoid-style manipulation platform that combines a mobile base, lift axis, robotic arms, and vision cameras for human-like high-precision operation.
specs: Integrated mobile base, lift axis, dual arms, and vision cameras

embodiedPlatforms.title: Embodied & Dev Platforms
embodiedPlatforms.intro: Platforms for VR, master-slave teleoperation, and embodied AI development workflows.

zarmvr.title: ZA-RMVR
zarmvr.summary: A teaching and research platform integrating a lift axis, dual robotic arms, dexterous end effectors, a core controller, and VR devices.
specs: 1× Gigabit Ethernet + 1× USB3.0 + 10 in / 10 out I/O

zarmps.title: ZA-RMPS
zarmps.summary: A dual-arm master-slave teleoperation platform for mirrored operation and control validation.
specs: Master/slave arms with 7 DOF / 640mm working radius
1× Gigabit Ethernet + 1× USB3.0 + 10 in / 10 out I/O

zardp.title: ZA-RDP
zardp.summary: A drawing robot platform for path teaching, drawing demos, and algorithm validation.

controller.title: Controller
controller.intro: Integrated control hardware for real-time motion, bus synchronization, and interface expansion.

zazg100.title: ZA-ZG100
zazg100.summary: An integrated controller focused on real-time robotics control and dense I/O integration.
specs: EtherCAT bus, 1ms control cycle, 5μs control jitter

accessories.title: Accessories
accessories.intro: Accessories are shown in a separate section to extend travel and rotation, and can be matched after the robot body is confirmed.

rail.title: Rail Platform
rail.summary: Extends long-range linear travel for linked stations and cross-station transfer.

rotatingplatform.title: Rotating Platform
rotatingplatform.summary: Adds rotational freedom for orientation adjustment and station transfer needs.
